goal: Share the per-row source observation/decode/preparation work across the 32-row observed cohort behind a guarded private seam, without changing any public input validation, output bytes, failure order, or timing duty. Targets P00's measured waste: all 79,940,126 input bytes re-read and re-parsed in every one of 32 rows; serial service 75.4220% read_arrow+next+from_wkb.
non_goals: No change to public RunAccessibility/RunBatch behavior for unadmitted inputs (designs/02:13 'API support is not reduced: unadmitted inputs continue down the existing route').
No compiled replay (P03), no typed MetricID v2 (P03), no drain changes (P04), no gate changes (P05).
No benchmark-only constructors or bypass paths (IMPLEMENTATION_MAP no-bypass rules: public path only).
No removal of per-row file validation, error chronology, or exporter duties.
No engine-internal algorithm changes; AccessibilityWElevation/Centrality semantics untouched.

admission_domain.condition: admit each format ONLY where reader-equivalence fixtures prove it (designs/02:82 'First admit single-file .geojson/.feather/.parquet only where tested'); engagement begins with the observed .geojson cohort shape and extends only on new conformance evidence
admission_domain.structure: single-file inputs only; Shapefile/prj/dbf/shx sidecars, archives, GDAL virtual files, mutable GeoDataFrames, custom reader hooks require a complete multi-resource identity and reader proof, otherwise fallback (designs/02:82-85)
excluded_from_initial_domain: obstacles/observers (not in observed cohort; UNA.py:333-334 gate untouched)
mixed-dimension geometry (falls back, not truncates; designs/02:101)
turns=True rows (C31-NOTE-3 cohort gate clause preserved)
admission_domain.data_conditions: missing columns or nonfinite data keep current validation/failure order; preparation never silently cleans (designs/02:84-85)

layers.name: SourceSnapshot
layers.content: exact bytes of one admitted input file, read once (Topology.py:55-61 pattern)
layers.law: these are the ONLY bytes hashed and decoded (TOCTOU)

layers.name: DecodedLayer
layers.content: GeoDataFrame decoded from the snapshot by the SAME extension-dispatched reader stack (gpd.read_feather(pa.BufferReader) / read_parquet / gpd.read_file(engine='pyogrio', use_arrow=True), Topology.py:64-78)
layers.law: byte-for-byte same reader stack and params as the produced path

layers.name: NetworkPrepared
layers.content: network arrays exactly as AddNetwork writes them (geometry, float64 lengths, float64 weights with bad-weight substitution + pinned warning, CRS as PROJJSON-carrying gdf.crs)
layers.law: dead column-loaded node ids (:303-313) may be omitted; BuildTopology-derived arrays (:1590-1623) are the live state

layers.name: AccessPrepared(role)
layers.content: per-role snapped access points exactly as BuildAccessPoints produces them (snap fields, weights, UID, dtypes, ordering)
layers.law: snap mechanics, uid dtype guard (:452-462), empty-layer path, and ordering hazards reproduced; role parameter (Origins/Destinations) is part of the key

layers.name: EnginePrepared
layers.content: engine payload reconstruction (worker-local geometry/STRtree once per dependency identity) ONLY when proof permits (designs/02:94-95)
layers.law: never transport GDALDataset/GEOS/STRtree pointers or open native handles across processes; increments A-C do not include this layer

layers.name: PreparedBundle
layers.content: the immutable published unit: identity, dependency-identity set, layer payloads, schema tag, producing code closure reference
layers.law: published once; consumers lease immutable views and materialize independent ordinary objects (designs/02:103-104)

identity_and_keys.composition: stage_key closure per cache/identity.py:135 over {file_sha256 of admitted snapshot bytes, params: {reader params implied by extension, producer-read settings: network_weight_column, network_precision, network_load_nodes, origin_weight_column, destination_weight_column, origin_uid_column, destination_id_column, default_cost}, profile: semantic_profile, env: geometry_env(profile, _PACKAGE_VERSION)}, plus preparation schema tag
identity_and_keys.over_key_meaning: bundle key is derived over the full per-role preparation parameter set (designs/02:11); per-dependency key granularity is a later refinement only after PP04 fixtures pass
forbidden_identity_inputs: float64-coerced reporting keys (E8: result_key coercion fixed in P03 before any metric reuse keys on it)
identity_and_keys.content_truth: the store does not enforce content-address truth (store-audit); the prepared admission MUST refuse bytes whose hash differs from the identity it claims (refuse-different-bytes, pattern cache/trace_residency.py:257-283)

toctou_law.statement: hash the SAME bytes that are decoded, never one version for the key and another for the payload (Topology.py:55-61 dossier-06 note)
toctou_law.admission: prepared admission re-verifies snapshot bytes against the claimed identity at lease time; a mismatch is a MISS (rebuild), never a served hit
toctou_law.hit_chronology: read/validation/failure chronology is still required on prepared hits (CLAUDE.md; audit section 10): existence checks, decode-or-restore decision, geometry/CRS/weight validations run against the SAME admitted bytes in the produced order

state_machine.transitions: ABSENT -> BUILDING(first consumer AFTER original validations) -> COMPLETE(publish once, atomic tmp->rename+fsync via ContentStore) -> LEASED(consumers hold immutable leases) -> (per-run teardown)
state_machine.crash_rule: crash-orphaned BUILDING is treated as ABSENT on next admission; ContentStore singleflight (cohort budget 600s, matching P00 configuration) covers concurrent build
state_machine.lazy_gate: first-consumer single-flight happens AFTER original validation (designs/02; audit I6): the producing validations run before any lookup, and on hits they re-run

chronology.prepared_hit_path: identical order; decode replaced by verified restore at the same chronology position; no validation skipped, no failure reordered
chronology.gate_class: integrity gates fatal only on fixed-input deterministic returns; run-parameter probe returns are data to record

restore_validity.engine_reads: every post-construction engine read must hold on the restored path (audit section 4, coordinator-verified): network.{start_nodes, end_nodes, weights, node_points, z}; origins.{edge_start_node, edge_end_node, weight_to_start, weight_to_end, geometry, crs}; destinations.{edge_start_node, edge_end_node, node_weight, weight_to_start, weight_to_end}; per-layer _stage_key (network/origins/destinations/obstacles); topology.{_stage_profile, cache_options, logger}; obstacles identity via get_partial_edge_corrections (AWE:613-744, 837-897, 899-942)
restore_validity.state_coverage: a restore that skips a field the engine later reads is a correctness defect; Topology stage-cache serializers are reusable ONLY for the exact state sets fixtures prove (errata: existence != full state coverage)
restore_validity.export_surface: exporter columns are ONLY origins geometry + engine arrays; PROJJSON CRS retained (:362-366); reach dtype int64 (WElevation) vs float64 (WTurns) preserved; exact exporter schema and Feather metadata law retained (designs/02:92)

mutability_law.immutable_internal_leases: prepared payloads are immutable and shared; leases never expose public mutable aliasing (CLAUDE.md)
mutability_law.per_consumer_materialization: on rehydration, independent ordinary objects are materialized BEFORE closing preparation leases; later user mutation of the returned topology must not alter shared payloads or another worker's state (designs/02:103-104)
mutability_law.defensive_copies_preserved: wherever the produced path copies (network.weights from lengths, :284), the prepared path hands each consumer its own copy
mutability_law.cluster_flags: per-row has_clusters=False reset semantics (:215, :560, :576) preserved on the prepared path
mutability_law.cache_policy: cache_options/_stage_profile refreshed from the ROW's settings (:188-193) even on hits
